title: Concept: File transfer over plaintext FTP (python)
description: In python, ftplib.FTP authenticates and transfers without encryption. Credentials and file contents are visible to every hop, and the failure is silent because the transfer still succeeds.
applicability: Batch jobs, partner integrations and backup scripts; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Credential theft and file tampering on the transfer path; MEDIUM severity.
